Who We Are

A lab partner that keeps every case moving

On Demand Dental Solutions combines traditional removable prosthetics with digital denture and full-arch workflows. From dentures and implant-assisted restorations to chairside conversion support, we work with your team to keep each case moving with clear communication and attention to detail.

Removable Prosthetics

Premium and immediate dentures, partial dentures, repairs and relines.

Implant-Assisted Dentures

Removable implant solutions with lab support for attachment selection and restorative workflows.

All-on-X & Full-Arch

Provisional and definitive full-arch solutions, including zirconia, coordinated from conversion through the final restoration.

Digital Dentures

Digital design and denture fabrication using scans or digitized conventional records.

Guards & Essix

Custom night guards and clear retainers prescribed by your practice.

Chairside Conversion

On-site conversion lab services and practical support for your doctor, assistants or in-house technician.

Chairside Support

Connecting the lab and the operatory

We assist dental teams with full-arch conversions, digital scan strategies, conventional impression workflows and denture troubleshooting.

  • i.Hands-on conversion lab services at your office
  • ii.Coaching for in-house technicians through each lab step
  • iii.Restorative workflow coordinated with your doctor
  • iv.Implant identification and component support
Schedule Chairside Support

Scheduled by arrangement. Travel fees may apply outside our local service area.

How It Works

Simple from
records to delivery

Start with digital scans or conventional impressions. We coordinate the records, materials and lab steps your case needs.

01

Discuss your case

Review the prescription, required records and requested delivery date with us. Book chairside support in advance when needed.

02

Submit scans through your connected scanner portal, or arrange delivery of conventional impressions and case materials.

03

We coordinate try-ins or design reviews, answer questions and confirm next steps with your team through delivery.
